pack: Grade 1 Math: Addition Fact Strategies Within 20

pages_detail.activities: One worked number-line example (8+3=11, start at 8, hop to 9, 10, 11); three problems where children draw their own counting hops from the pre-circled big number
pages_detail.title: Count On from the Big Number

pages_detail.activities: Worked Before/After ten-frame example (9+4: gold dot moves into the first frame to complete 10, 3 coral dots remain); three practice problems with dashed empty slots, a small move arrow, and single-line stepped equations
pages_detail.title: Make 10 First

pages_detail.activities: Worked example 6+6=12; match three doubles cards to scrambled sums; finish two doubles; find two missing addends
answers: 7 + 7 goes to 14; 4 + 4 goes to 8; 5 + 5 goes to 10
pages_detail.title: Doubles

pages_detail.activities: Worked example 7+8=7+7+1=15; four near doubles where the adjustment stays inside the second group (ringed extra dot for +1, crossed-out dot for -1), readable in grayscale
pages_detail.title: Near Doubles

pages_detail.activities: Six problems; for each, circle one of four outlined strategy choices (Count On, Make 10, Double, Near Double) and solve in a spacious answer box; rows separated by subtle lines
answers: Any strategy that gives the correct sum is right
pages_detail.title: Pick Your Strategy
